title: Theories of “Sexuality” in Natural Language Processing Bias Research

bias_targets.methodology: Survey and meta-analysis of 55 NLP research articles to evaluate how sexuality and anti-queer bias are theorized, operationalized (e.g., via identity word lists and human annotation), and quantified (e.g., using toxicity/hate classifiers, counterfactual sentence comparisons, generation likelihood, and word embedding associations).
